packageRules.description: pnpm itself is updated through packageManager / .tool-versions, not as a devDependency, so it got its own unscheduled PR re-run on every rebase (2026-10-07). Minor/patch wait for Monday; majors still arrive alone.

Block TypeScript major bumps. TS7 ships the native (Go) compiler, whose JS API shim lacks getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile — nest/tsc-based build toolchains crash on it. Re-enable deliberately once the toolchain supports TS7.
